summary_md: **Towhid Khan ([@yourtowhid](https://x.com/yourtowhid/status/2116654186624598199))** highlights NVIDIA **Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe**, a 34B MoE with 4.3B active (~21.6 GB NVFP4) producing speaker-tagged, word-timestamped transcripts of hour-long audio in 40 languages offline on one RTX 5090, via vLLM or GGML ([nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe-30B-A4B)).
relevance: Local speech model for media pipelines.
